title: IRGC Says Two Supertankers Hit Naval Mines Near Strait of Hormuz
detail: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two supertankers struck naval mines near the Strait of Hormuz, per an aggregated headline published Oct 23. Only the headline was available; vessel names, flags, exact location, damage and any independent confirmation (e.g. UKMTO) were not verified, so the claim is unconfirmed.
